# Configuring a {{ gcp_short }} project {#installing-gcp-account}

Before you can install OpenShift Container Platform, you must configure a {{ gcp_first }} project to host it. You can configure custom roles and permissions, DNS configuration, and manage your own {{ gcp_short }} firewall rules.

**Additional resources**

- [Reducing permissions while using the {{ gcp_short }} CSI Driver Operator](/openshift-docs-markdown/storage/container_storage_interface/persistent-storage-csi-gcp-pd#persistent-storage-csi-gcp-pd-reduce-permissions_persistent-storage-csi-gcp-pd)

## Next steps {#_next_steps}

- Install an OpenShift Container Platform cluster on {{ gcp_short }}. You can [install a customized cluster](/openshift-docs-markdown/installing/installing_gcp/installing-gcp-customizations#installing-gcp-customizations) or [quickly install a cluster](/openshift-docs-markdown/installing/installing_gcp/installing-gcp-default#installing-gcp-default) with default options.
